+SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
+REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
+
+ROOT="$REPO_ROOT/grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0"
+CHECK=false SMOKE=false
+VARGS=()
+
+usage() { sed -n '2,/^# =====.*$/p' "$0" | sed -n '2,26p' | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//' >&2; exit 2; }
+die() { echo "freeze: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
+
+while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
+  case "$1" in
+    --root) ROOT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
+    --smoke) SMOKE=true; VARGS+=(--smoke); shift ;;
+    --check) CHECK=true; shift ;;
+    --allow-partial) VARGS+=(--allow-partial); shift ;;
+    --suite-file) [[ -n "${2:-}" ]] || die "--suite-file needs a path"; VARGS+=(--suite-file "$2"); shift 2 ;;
+    --help|-h) usage ;;
+    *) die "unknown option: $1 (see --help)" ;;
+  esac
+done
+[[ -n "$ROOT" && -d "$ROOT" ]] || die "suite root not found: ${ROOT:-<empty>}"
+ROOT="$(cd "$ROOT" && pwd)"
+MANIFEST="$ROOT/MANIFEST.sha256"
+
+vrc=0
+"$SCRIPT_DIR/validate-suite.sh" --root "$ROOT" ${VARGS[@]+"${VARGS[@]}"} || vrc=$?
+if [[ $vrc -eq 1 ]]; then echo "freeze: refused — the suite does not validate" >&2; exit 1; fi
+[[ $vrc -eq 0 ]] || die "validate-suite.sh failed (exit $vrc)"
+
+# compute_manifest <out> — the manifest body for the current tree.
+compute_manifest() {
+  local out="$1" list dirs=(tasks)
+  [[ "$SMOKE" == "true" ]] && dirs+=(smoke)
+  list="$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/freeze-list.XXXXXX")"
+  local d
+  for d in "${dirs[@]}"; do
+    [[ -d "$ROOT/$d" ]] || continue
+    ( cd "$ROOT" && find "$d" -type f -print )
+  done | LC_ALL=C sort > "$list"
+  if grep -q '\\' "$list"; then rm -f "$list"; die "a path under the suite holds a backslash"; fi
+  python3 -I - "$ROOT" "$list" > "$out" <<'PY' || { rm -f "$list"; die "hashing failed"; }
+import hashlib, os, sys
+root, listing = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
+for rel in open(listing, encoding="utf-8").read().splitlines():
+    if not rel:
+        continue
+    h = hashlib.sha256()
+    with open(os.path.join(root, rel), "rb") as f:
+        for b in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
+            h.update(b)
+    print(h.hexdigest() + "  " + rel)
+PY
+  rm -f "$list"
+}
+digest_of() { python3 -I -c 'import hashlib, sys; print(hashlib.sha256(open(sys.argv[1], "rb").read()).hexdigest())' "$1"; }
+
+TMP="$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/freeze.XXXXXX")"
+trap 'rm -f "$TMP"' EXIT
+compute_manifest "$TMP"
+n="$(grep -c . "$TMP" || true)"
+
+if [[ "$CHECK" == "true" ]]; then
+  [[ -f "$MANIFEST" ]] || { echo "freeze: no MANIFEST.sha256 in $ROOT (run freeze.sh first)" >&2; exit 1; }
+  if cmp -s "$TMP" "$MANIFEST"; then
+    echo "freeze: OK — $n files match MANIFEST.sha256 (sha256 $(digest_of "$MANIFEST"))"
+    exit 0
+  fi
+  echo "freeze: DRIFT against $MANIFEST:"
+  python3 -I - "$MANIFEST" "$TMP" <<'PY'
+import sys
+def load(p):
+    m = {}
+    for line in open(p, encoding="utf-8"):
+        line = line.rstrip("\n")
+        if line:
+            h, _, rel = line.partition("  ")
+            m[rel] = h
+    return m
+old, new = load(sys.argv[1]), load(sys.argv[2])
+for rel in sorted(set(old) | set(new)):
+    if rel not in new:
+        print(f"  removed  {rel}")
+    elif rel not in old:
+        print(f"  added    {rel}")
+    elif old[rel] != new[rel]:
+        print(f"  changed  {rel}")
+PY
+  exit 1
+fi
+
+cp "$TMP" "$MANIFEST.tmp" && mv "$MANIFEST.tmp" "$MANIFEST"
+echo "freeze: wrote MANIFEST.sha256 ($n files, sha256 $(digest_of "$MANIFEST"))"
+exit 0

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# =============================================================================
+# evals/harness/lib/sandbox-mount.sh — sandbox materialisation and arm toggles
+#
+# cycle-130 Sprint 258 Task 1.6 (SDD D-4.5, DEC-0421, DEC-0423, DEC-0396).
+# Extracted from execute-agent.sh (cycle-129 step 2 and the toggle functions)
+# WITHOUT behaviour change for the cycle-129 single-skill path, and shared with
+# pipeline-run.sh. Source it; it defines functions only and sets no shell
+# options (the caller runs under `set -euo pipefail`).
+#
+# Contract (every function returns 0 on success, 2 when refused / when a step
+# cannot take effect; refusals name the reason on one stderr line):
+#
+#   mount_prompt_surface <ws> <prompt_tree> <skill|->
+#       skill given: <ws>/.claude/skills/<skill>/ (whole dir), .claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md,
+#       .claude/rules/, CLAUDE.md = "@.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md"; the prompt tree's
+#       .loa.config.yaml only in arm mode (LOA_EVAL_ARM set), as cycle-129 did.
+#       skill "-": the whole .claude/ tree is copied (files, never a symlink to the
+#       tree), CLAUDE.md as above, and .loa.config.yaml always (the pipeline
+#       executor needs every skill, hook and script). Evidence: mount=skill:<s>|tree.
+#   resolve_arm_toggles <arm> <suite_file>
+#       prints the arm's toggles as compact JSON on stdout. Arms are read from
+#       `.arms[]` (ablation-2.0) and `.ab.arms[]` (recall suites). An arm with
+#       toggles {} (a1_full, baseline) prints {}; `baseline` undeclared prints {}.
+#       Exit 2: undeclared arm (an unreadable suite file declares none), `absent: true` arm.
+#   apply_arm_toggles <ws> <toggles_json> <arm>
+#       applies every toggle to the SANDBOX COPY and verifies it afterwards; exit 2
+#       when one cannot take effect or is unknown. Toggles and values:
+#         companion_voice: false  flatline_protocol.{code_review,security_audit}.companion_voice=false
+#         karpathy_block: false   '## Karpathy Principles' out of CLAUDE.loa.md (+ constraints.json rows)
+#         rule_files: false       stash-safety.md, skill-invariants.md out of .claude/rules/
+#         audit_delta_instruction: false  the delta paragraph out of auditing-security/SKILL.md
+#         loa_mount: false        verifies no .claude/, CLAUDE.md, .loa.config.yaml in <ws>
+#                                 (the caller skips mount_prompt_surface); evidence loa_mount=none
+#         effort: low|medium|high|xhigh|max
+#                                 every `effort:` line out of the frontmatter of every
+#                                 <ws>/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md; every `default_effort` key in
+#                                 <ws>/.claude/defaults/model-config.yaml set to the value and its
+#                                 .checksum (bare sha256 hex) refreshed when present.
+#                                 The caller passes `--effort <v>` on argv.
+#         gates: false            flatline_protocol.{code_review,security_audit}.enabled=false;
+#                                 LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false exported in the CALLING shell
+#                                 and written to $ARM_ENV_FILE (KEY=VALUE lines) when that is set
+#         flatline: false         flatline_protocol.enabled=false
+#         sprint_plan: false, context_resets: false
+#                                 phase-set edits owned by the pipeline executor; recorded as
+#                                 evidence here (the single-skill executor refuses them itself)
+#   regen_sandbox_manifest <ws>
+#       writes <ws>/.claude/checksums.json {generated, algorithm: sha256, files} over
+#       every regular file under <ws>/.claude except overrides/ and the manifest
+#       itself (LC_ALL=C order, sha256). tools/gen-checksums.sh (in the
+#       prompt tree, $EVAL_PROMPT_TREE) is used instead when it exists AND <ws> is a
+#       git repository tracking .claude files (it lists `git ls-files`). No .claude/
+#       (loa_mount: false) → manifest_sha256=none, exit 0. Prints manifest_sha256=<hex>.
+#   check_fixture_path_rule <fixture_dir>
+#       exit 2 (offending paths on stderr) when the fixture's top level holds
+#       .claude, CLAUDE.md, .loa.config.yaml, grimoires or .run — the mount owns
+#       those paths (DEC-0396); exit 0 otherwise.
+#   write_sandbox_grimoire <ws> <task_yaml> <arm> <sprint_label>
+#       grimoires/loa/ledger.json (one active cycle, <sprint_label> planned, global 1;
+#       the ledger-lib.sh schema), NOTES.md (header only), context/task-brief.md (the
+#       task's agent-facing `criterion` + the TASK.md next to task.yaml),
+#       a2a/<sprint_label>/ (empty); review-catch tasks also get a one-sprint
+#       grimoires/loa/sprint.md naming pr/head.diff and a2a/<sprint_label>/reviewer.md
+#       carrying pr/PR.md (sandbox copy, else the corpus fixture's). An arm whose
+#       toggles carry sprint_plan: false (resolved from $LOA_EVAL_SUITE_FILE, default
+#       evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml) gets NO sprint.md. Build tasks leave sprint.md
+#       to the PLAN phase. Nothing written names the arm.
+#   init_sandbox_beads <ws> <task_title>
+#       `br init --prefix bd --no-daemon` in <ws> plus one task bead with the title
+#       when br ($LOA_EVAL_BR_BIN, default br) is on PATH → beads=br; else the opt-out
+#       marker through <ws>/.claude/scripts/beads/update-beads-state.sh --opt-out →
+#       beads=opt-out; neither → beads=none (exit 0).
+#
+# Hashing is Python hashlib (_sm_sha256), never .claude/ code: see _sm_sha256.
+# Callers source this file by a literal relative path (no variable expansion
+# on the source line), as eval.yml's trust-boundary scan requires.
+#
+# Evidence: every function reports `key=value` lines (one line, no newline in
+# the value). When ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE is set they are appended to that file;
+# else they go to the descriptor in SANDBOX_MOUNT_EVIDENCE_FD (default 1).
+# resolve_arm_toggles prints JSON on stdout and no evidence.
+#
+# Tested by evals/tests/arm-toggles.bats (directly and through execute-agent.sh)
+# and evals/tests/execute-agent.bats.
+# =============================================================================
+
+[[ "${_SANDBOX_MOUNT_LOADED:-}" == "true" ]] && return 0
+_SANDBOX_MOUNT_LOADED=true
+
+_SM_LIB_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
+_SM_REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$_SM_LIB_DIR/../../.." && pwd)"
+
+_sm_err() { echo "ERROR: $*" >&2; }
+
+# _sm_sha256 <file>... prints "<hex>  <file>" lines, the sha256sum output shape.
+# Python hashlib, not compat-lib's sha256_portable: the eval workflow runs the
+# harness as the trusted copy against a PR's .claude/, so no harness script
+# sources .claude/ code (eval.yml "Validate grader trust boundary"); run-arms.sh
+# hashes the corpus the same way.
+_sm_sha256() {
+  python3 -I -c '
+import hashlib, sys
+for p in sys.argv[1:]:
+    h = hashlib.sha256()
+    with open(p, "rb") as f:
+        for b in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
+            h.update(b)
+    print(h.hexdigest() + "  " + p)' "$@"
+}
+
+# _sm_evidence <key> <value> — one key=value line to the evidence sink.
+_sm_evidence() {
+  local line="$1=${2//$'\n'/ }"
+  if [[ -n "${ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE:-}" ]]; then
+    printf '%s\n' "$line" >> "$ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE"
+  else
+    local fd="${SANDBOX_MOUNT_EVIDENCE_FD:-1}"
+    [[ "$fd" =~ ^[0-9]$ ]] || fd=1
+    printf '%s\n' "$line" >&"$fd"
+  fi
+}
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+mount_prompt_surface() {
+  local ws="$1" tree="$2" skill="${3:-}"
+  [[ -d "$ws" ]] || { _sm_err "mount_prompt_surface: workspace not found: $ws"; return 2; }
+  [[ -d "$tree/.claude" ]] || { _sm_err "mount_prompt_surface: prompt tree has no .claude/: $tree"; return 2; }
+  if [[ "$skill" == "-" ]]; then
+    mkdir -p "$ws/.claude"
+    cp -a "$tree/.claude/." "$ws/.claude/" || { _sm_err "mount_prompt_surface: copying .claude/ failed"; return 2; }
+    printf '@.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md\n' > "$ws/CLAUDE.md"
+    if [[ -f "$tree/.loa.config.yaml" ]]; then cp "$tree/.loa.config.yaml" "$ws/.loa.config.yaml"; fi
+    _sm_evidence mount "tree"
+    return 0
+  fi
+  case "$skill" in */*|.*|'') _sm_err "invalid skill name '$skill'"; return 2 ;; esac
+  local skill_src="$tree/.claude/skills/$skill"
+  [[ -f "$skill_src/SKILL.md" ]] || { _sm_err "prompt tree $tree has no .claude/skills/$skill/SKILL.md"; return 2; }
+  mkdir -p "$ws/.claude/skills" "$ws/.claude/loa"
+  # Whole skill dir (resources included) so guarded reads inside the skill resolve.
+  local skill_dst="$ws/.claude/skills/$skill"
+  mkdir -p "$skill_dst"
+  cp -a "$skill_src/." "$skill_dst/"
+  if [[ -f "$tree/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md" ]]; then
+    cp "$tree/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md" "$ws/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md"
+  fi
+  if [[ -d "$tree/.claude/rules" ]]; then
+    mkdir -p "$ws/.claude/rules"
+    cp -a "$tree/.claude/rules/." "$ws/.claude/rules/"
+  fi
+  printf '@.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md\n' > "$ws/CLAUDE.md"
+  if [[ -n "${LOA_EVAL_ARM+x}" && -f "$tree/.loa.config.yaml" ]]; then
+    cp "$tree/.loa.config.yaml" "$ws/.loa.config.yaml"
+  fi
+  _sm_evidence mount "skill:$skill"
+  return 0
+}
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+resolve_arm_toggles() {
+  local arm="$1" suite_file="${2:-}"
+  [[ "$arm" =~ ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$ ]] || { _sm_err "invalid arm id '$arm'"; return 2; }
+  local found=0 entry=""
+  if [[ -n "$suite_file" && -f "$suite_file" ]]; then
+    # an unreadable suite file reads as "not declared" (cycle-129 behaviour: baseline still resolves to {})
+    entry="$(ARM="$arm" yq -o=json -I=0 '[((.arms // [])[]), ((.ab.arms // [])[])] | map(select(.id == strenv(ARM))) | .[0] // null' "$suite_file" 2>/dev/null)" \
+      || entry=""
+    [[ -n "$entry" && "$entry" != "null" ]] && found=1
+  fi
+  if [[ "$found" -eq 0 ]]; then
+    [[ "$arm" == "baseline" ]] && { printf '{}'; return 0; }
+    _sm_err "arm '$arm' is not declared in ${suite_file:-any suite} (arms[] / ab.arms[])"
+    return 2
+  fi
+  if [[ "$(jq -r '.absent // false' <<<"$entry")" == "true" ]]; then
+    _sm_err "arm '$arm' is declared absent in $suite_file (never run): $(jq -r '.evidence // "no evidence"' <<<"$entry")"
+    return 2
+  fi
+  local t
+  t="$(jq -c '.toggles // {}' <<<"$entry")"
+  jq -e 'type == "object"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$t" || { _sm_err "arm '$arm' toggles are not an object in $suite_file"; return 2; }
+  printf '%s' "$t"
+}
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Remove the markdown section that starts at the exact heading line $2 (up to
+# the next level-2 heading) from file $1. Prints the number of lines removed.
+_sm_drop_md_section() {
+  local f="$1" heading="$2" tmpdir="$3" tmp
+  tmp="$(mktemp "$tmpdir/.arm.XXXXXX")"
+  awk -v h="$heading" '
+    $0 == h { skip = 1; n++; next }
+    skip && /^## / { skip = 0 }
+    skip { n++; next }
+    { print }
+    END { print n + 0 > "/dev/stderr" }' "$f" > "$tmp" 2> "$tmp.n"
+  mv "$tmp" "$f"
+  cat "$tmp.n"; rm -f "$tmp.n"
+}
+
+# Remove the first blank-line-delimited paragraph of $1 that contains one of
+# the needles (tried in order, case-insensitive). Writes the removed text to
+# $2; exit 1 when no needle matches.
+_sm_drop_paragraph() {
+  python3 -I - "$1" "$2" "look for what the review did not" "Confirm the review's demotions independently" <<'PY'
+import re, sys
+path, out = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
+text = open(path, encoding="utf-8").read()
+paras = re.split(r"(\n[ \t]*\n)", text)
+for needle in sys.argv[3:]:
+    for i in range(0, len(paras), 2):
+        if needle.lower() in paras[i].lower():
+            removed = paras[i]
+            # drop the paragraph and the separator that follows it
+            del paras[i:i + 2]
+            open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8").write("".join(paras))
+            open(out, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(removed + "\n")
+            sys.exit(0)
+sys.exit(1)
+PY
+}
+
+# Strip every `effort:` line from the YAML frontmatter of file $1 (frontmatter
+# = line 1 `---` up to the next `---`). Prints 1 when a line was removed, else 0.
+_sm_strip_frontmatter_effort() {
+  local f="$1" tmp
+  tmp="$(mktemp "$f.XXXXXX")"
+  awk '
+    NR == 1 && $0 == "---" { fm = 1; print; next }
+    fm == 1 && $0 == "---" { fm = 2; print; next }
+    fm == 1 && /^effort:/ { n++; next }
+    { print }
+    END { print (n > 0 ? 1 : 0) > "/dev/stderr" }' "$f" > "$tmp" 2> "$tmp.n"
+  cat "$tmp" > "$f"; rm -f "$tmp"
+  cat "$tmp.n"; rm -f "$tmp.n"
+}
+
+# 0 when file $1's frontmatter still carries an `effort:` line.
+_sm_frontmatter_has_effort() {
+  awk 'NR == 1 && $0 != "---" { exit 1 } NR > 1 && $0 == "---" { exit 1 } NR > 1 && /^effort:/ { found = 1; exit 0 } END { exit (found ? 0 : 1) }' "$1"
+}
+
+_sm_cfg_set_false() {  # _sm_cfg_set_false <cfg> <yq-path>... ; verifies each
+  local cfg="$1"; shift
+  [[ -f "$cfg" ]] || : > "$cfg"
+  local p
+  for p in "$@"; do
+    P="$p" yq -i 'eval(strenv(P)) = false' "$cfg" 2>/dev/null || return 1
+    [[ "$(P="$p" yq -r 'eval(strenv(P))' "$cfg" 2>/dev/null)" == "false" ]] || return 1
+  done
+  return 0
+}
+
+apply_arm_toggles() {
+  local ws="$1" toggles="${2:-}" arm="${3:-}"
+  [[ -d "$ws" ]] || { _sm_err "apply_arm_toggles: workspace not found: $ws"; return 2; }
+  [[ -n "$toggles" ]] || toggles='{}'
+  jq -e 'type == "object"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$toggles" || { _sm_err "arm '$arm' toggles are not a JSON object"; return 2; }
+  local eval_dir="$ws/.eval"
+  mkdir -p "$eval_dir"
+  local key val
+  while IFS=$'\t' read -r key val; do
+    [[ -n "$key" ]] || continue
+    if [[ "$key" == "effort" ]]; then
+      case "$val" in low|medium|high|xhigh|max) ;; *) _sm_err "arm '$arm' toggle effort=$val (want low|medium|high|xhigh|max)"; return 2 ;; esac
+    elif [[ "$val" != "false" ]]; then
+      _sm_err "arm '$arm' toggle $key=$val (only false is defined)"; return 2
+    fi
+    case "$key" in
+      companion_voice)
+        _sm_cfg_set_false "$ws/.loa.config.yaml" .flatline_protocol.code_review.companion_voice .flatline_protocol.security_audit.companion_voice \
+          || { _sm_err "companion_voice toggle did not take effect"; return 2; }
+        _sm_evidence companion_voice "flatline_protocol.{code_review,security_audit}.companion_voice=false"
+        ;;
+      karpathy_block)
+        local k="$ws/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md" n
+        [[ -f "$k" ]] || { _sm_err "karpathy_block toggle: no sandbox CLAUDE.loa.md"; return 2; }
+        n="$(_sm_drop_md_section "$k" '## Karpathy Principles' "$eval_dir")"
+        if [[ "${n:-0}" -eq 0 ]] || grep -q '^## Karpathy Principles' "$k"; then
+          _sm_err "karpathy_block toggle: no '## Karpathy Principles' section removed"; return 2
+        fi
+        local cj="$ws/.claude/data/constraints.json" cjn="none"
+        if [[ -f "$cj" ]]; then
+          # audit r1 DISS-C-008: a failed rewrite is exit 2, not a silent pass; verify afterwards
+          jq '(.constraints // []) |= map(select((tostring | test("karpathy"; "i")) | not))' "$cj" > "$cj.tmp" \
+            || { rm -f "$cj.tmp"; _sm_err "karpathy_block toggle: constraints.json could not be rewritten"; return 2; }
+          mv "$cj.tmp" "$cj"
+          cjn="$(jq '[(.constraints // [])[] | select(tostring | test("karpathy"; "i"))] | length' "$cj" 2>/dev/null || echo "?")"
+          [[ "$cjn" == "0" ]] || { _sm_err "karpathy_block toggle: constraints.json still carries Karpathy rows ($cjn)"; return 2; }
+        fi
+        _sm_evidence karpathy_block "removed ${n} lines from CLAUDE.loa.md; constraints.json karpathy rows after: ${cjn}"
+        ;;
+      rule_files)
+        local r gone=""
+        for r in stash-safety.md skill-invariants.md; do
+          if [[ -e "$ws/.claude/rules/$r" ]]; then rm -f "$ws/.claude/rules/$r"; gone="$gone $r"; fi
+          [[ ! -e "$ws/.claude/rules/$r" ]] || { _sm_err "rule_files toggle: $r still present"; return 2; }
+        done
+        _sm_evidence rule_files "removed:${gone:- none present}"
+        ;;
+      audit_delta_instruction)
+        local s="$ws/.claude/skills/auditing-security/SKILL.md"
+        [[ -f "$s" ]] || { _sm_err "audit_delta_instruction toggle: no sandbox auditing-security/SKILL.md"; return 2; }
+        _sm_drop_paragraph "$s" "$eval_dir/arm-removed.txt" \
+          || { _sm_err "audit_delta_instruction toggle: no delta paragraph found in the sandbox SKILL.md"; return 2; }
+        _sm_evidence audit_delta_instruction "removed $(wc -c < "$eval_dir/arm-removed.txt" | tr -d ' ') bytes (.eval/arm-removed.txt)"
+        ;;
+      loa_mount)
+        local p left=""
+        for p in .claude CLAUDE.md .loa.config.yaml; do
+          if [[ -e "$ws/$p" || -L "$ws/$p" ]]; then left="$left $p"; fi
+        done
+        [[ -z "$left" ]] || { _sm_err "loa_mount toggle: the sandbox still holds:$left (mount_prompt_surface must be skipped)"; return 2; }
+        _sm_evidence loa_mount "none"
+        ;;
+      effort)
+        local f total=0 stripped=0 still=""
+        for f in "$ws"/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md; do
+          [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue
+          total=$((total + 1))
+          if [[ "$(_sm_strip_frontmatter_effort "$f")" == "1" ]]; then stripped=$((stripped + 1)); fi
+          if _sm_frontmatter_has_effort "$f"; then still="$still ${f#"$ws"/}"; fi
+        done
+        [[ -z "$still" ]] || { _sm_err "effort toggle: effort: still in the frontmatter of:$still"; return 2; }
+        local mc="$ws/.claude/defaults/model-config.yaml" cat_state="absent"
+        if [[ -f "$mc" ]]; then
+          local nkeys
+          nkeys="$(yq '[.. | select(tag == "!!map" and has("default_effort"))] | length' "$mc" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
+          [[ "$nkeys" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && "$nkeys" -gt 0 ]] \
+            || { _sm_err "effort toggle: no default_effort key in the sandbox model-config.yaml"; return 2; }
+          V="$val" yq -i '(.. | select(tag == "!!map" and has("default_effort")) | .default_effort) = strenv(V)' "$mc" \
+            || { _sm_err "effort toggle: yq failed on the sandbox model-config.yaml"; return 2; }
+          local wrong
+          wrong="$(V="$val" yq '[.. | select(tag == "!!map" and has("default_effort")) | select(.default_effort != strenv(V))] | length' "$mc" 2>/dev/null || echo 1)"
+          [[ "$wrong" == "0" ]] || { _sm_err "effort toggle: default_effort did not take effect"; return 2; }
+          cat_state="default_effort=$val in $nkeys entries"
+          if [[ -f "$mc.checksum" ]]; then
+            local h
+            h="$(_sm_sha256 "$mc" | awk '{print $1}')"
+            [[ "$h" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]] || { _sm_err "effort toggle: could not hash model-config.yaml"; return 2; }
+            printf '%s\n' "$h" > "$mc.checksum"
+            cat_state="$cat_state; .checksum refreshed"
+          fi
+        fi
+        _sm_evidence effort "$val"
+        _sm_evidence effort_skills_stripped "$stripped/$total"
+        _sm_evidence effort_catalog "$cat_state"
+        ;;
+      gates)
+        _sm_cfg_set_false "$ws/.loa.config.yaml" .flatline_protocol.code_review.enabled .flatline_protocol.security_audit.enabled \
+          || { _sm_err "gates toggle did not take effect"; return 2; }
+        export LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false
+        if [[ -n "${ARM_ENV_FILE:-}" ]]; then printf 'LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false\n' >> "$ARM_ENV_FILE"; fi
+        _sm_evidence gates "flatline_protocol.{code_review,security_audit}.enabled=false"
+        _sm_evidence arm_env "LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false"
+        ;;
+      flatline)
+        _sm_cfg_set_false "$ws/.loa.config.yaml" .flatline_protocol.enabled \
+          || { _sm_err "flatline toggle did not take effect"; return 2; }
+        _sm_evidence flatline "flatline_protocol.enabled=false"
+        ;;
+      sprint_plan)
+        _sm_evidence sprint_plan "phase set without PLAN (pipeline executor); no sprint.md materialised"
+        ;;
+      context_resets)
+        _sm_evidence context_resets "implementer phases continue one session (pipeline executor)"
+        ;;
+      *) _sm_err "arm '$arm' declares unknown toggle '$key'"; return 2 ;;
+    esac
+  done < <(jq -r 'to_entries[] | [.key, (.value | tostring)] | @tsv' <<<"$toggles")
+  return 0
+}
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+regen_sandbox_manifest() {
+  local ws="$1"
+  [[ -d "$ws" ]] || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: workspace not found: $ws"; return 2; }
+  if [[ ! -d "$ws/.claude" ]]; then
+    _sm_evidence manifest_sha256 "none"
+    return 0
+  fi
+  local out="$ws/.claude/checksums.json" tool="${EVAL_PROMPT_TREE:-$_SM_REPO_ROOT}/tools/gen-checksums.sh" how="inline"
+  if [[ -x "$tool" ]] && git -C "$ws" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 \
+     && [[ -n "$(git -C "$ws" ls-files .claude 2>/dev/null | head -1)" ]]; then
+    "$tool" --root "$ws" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: $tool --root $ws failed"; return 2; }
+    how="gen-checksums.sh"
+  else
+    local list="$ws/.eval/.manifest-files" sums="$ws/.eval/.manifest-sums"
+    mkdir -p "$ws/.eval"
+    ( cd "$ws" && find .claude -type f ! -path '.claude/overrides/*' ! -path '.claude/checksums.json' -print ) \
+      | LC_ALL=C sort > "$list"
+    if grep -q '\\' "$list"; then _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: a path under .claude/ holds a backslash"; rm -f "$list"; return 2; fi
+    : > "$sums"
+    local -a batch=()
+    local f
+    while IFS= read -r f; do
+      batch+=("$f")
+      if [[ ${#batch[@]} -ge 200 ]]; then
+        ( cd "$ws" && _sm_sha256 "${batch[@]}" ) >> "$sums" || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: hashing failed"; return 2; }
+        batch=()
+      fi
+    done < "$list"
+    if [[ ${#batch[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
+      ( cd "$ws" && _sm_sha256 "${batch[@]}" ) >> "$sums" || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: hashing failed"; return 2; }
+    fi
+    jq -Rn --arg generated "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" '
+      {generated: $generated, algorithm: "sha256",
+       files: ([inputs | select(length > 0) | capture("^(?<h>[0-9a-f]{64})  (?<p>.+)$") | {key: .p, value: .h}] | from_entries)}' \
+      < "$sums" > "$out.tmp" || { rm -f "$out.tmp" "$list" "$sums"; _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: could not write the manifest"; return 2; }
+    mv "$out.tmp" "$out"
+    rm -f "$list" "$sums"
+  fi
+  jq -e '.files | type == "object"' "$out" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: $out is not a manifest"; return 2; }
+  local digest
+  digest="$(_sm_sha256 "$out" | awk '{print $1}')"
+  _sm_evidence manifest_files "$(jq '.files | length' "$out") ($how)"
+  _sm_evidence manifest_sha256 "$digest"
+  return 0
+}
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+check_fixture_path_rule() {
+  local dir="$1"
+  [[ -d "$dir" ]] || { _sm_err "check_fixture_path_rule: fixture not found: $dir"; return 2; }
+  local p bad=""
+  for p in .claude CLAUDE.md .loa.config.yaml grimoires .run; do
+    if [[ -e "$dir/$p" || -L "$dir/$p" ]]; then bad="$bad $p"; fi
+  done
+  if [[ -n "$bad" ]]; then
+    echo "fixture path rule: $dir holds paths the Loa mount owns:$bad" >&2
+    return 2
+  fi
+  return 0
+}

+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+write_sandbox_grimoire() {
+  local ws="$1" task="$2" arm="$3" label="${4:-sprint-1}"
+  [[ -d "$ws" ]] || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: workspace not found: $ws"; return 2; }
+  [[ -f "$task" ]] || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: task yaml not found: $task"; return 2; }
+  [[ "$label" =~ ^sprint-[0-9]{1,4}$ ]] || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: invalid sprint label '$label'"; return 2; }
+  local tid ttype criterion task_md
+  tid="$(yq -r '.id // ""' "$task")"; ttype="$(yq -r '.type // ""' "$task")"
+  criterion="$(yq -r '.criterion // ""' "$task")"
+  [[ "$tid" =~ ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,63}$ ]] || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: task id '$tid' invalid"; return 2; }
+  [[ -n "$criterion" && "$criterion" != "null" ]] || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: task $tid has no criterion"; return 2; }
+  task_md="$(dirname "$task")/TASK.md"
+  [[ -f "$task_md" ]] || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: no TASK.md beside $task"; return 2; }
+
+  local sprint_plan=true
+  if [[ -n "$arm" ]]; then
+    local sf="${LOA_EVAL_SUITE_FILE:-$_SM_REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml}" tg
+    if tg="$(resolve_arm_toggles "$arm" "$sf" 2>/dev/null)"; then
+      [[ "$(jq -r 'if has("sprint_plan") then (.sprint_plan | tostring) else "true" end' <<<"$tg")" == "false" ]] && sprint_plan=false
+    fi
+  fi
+
+  local g="$ws/grimoires/loa" now
+  now="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
+  mkdir -p "$g/context" "$g/a2a/$label"
+  jq -n --arg now "$now" --arg label "$label" --arg tid "$tid" '
+    {version: 1, schema_version: 1, created: $now, last_updated: $now,
+     next_sprint_number: 2, global_sprint_counter: 1, active_cycle: "cycle-001",
+     cycles: [{id: "cycle-001", label: ("eval task " + $tid), status: "active", created: $now,
+               archived: null, archive_path: null, prd: null, sdd: null,
+               sprints: [{global_id: 1, local_label: $label, status: "planned", created: $now, completed: null}]}],
+     bugfixes: [], bugfix_cycles: []}' > "$g/ledger.json" \
+    || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: ledger write failed"; return 2; }
+  printf '# NOTES\n' > "$g/NOTES.md"
+  {
+    printf '# Task brief\n\n## Criterion\n\n%s\n\n## Task\n\n' "$criterion"
+    cat "$task_md"
+  } > "$g/context/task-brief.md"
+  local wrote="ledger.json NOTES.md context/task-brief.md a2a/$label/"
+
+  if [[ "$ttype" == "review-catch" && "$sprint_plan" == "true" ]]; then
+    {
+      printf '# Sprint Plan\n\n## Sprint %s: Review the pull request in pr/\n\n' "${label#sprint-}"
+      printf 'The change under review is `pr/head.diff` (unified diff, base to head). The files before the change are under `pr/base/`, after it under `pr/head/`; `pr/PR.md` is the pull request description and is the implementation report for this sprint.\n\n'
+      printf '### Tasks\n\n- [x] Task 1.1: the change in `pr/head.diff`\n\n'
+      printf '### Review scope\n\nThe gates review `pr/head.diff` (pass `--diff-file pr/head.diff` to the adversarial review). Cite findings as `head/<path>:<line>` with lines from the `pr/head/` files.\n\n'
+      printf '## Success Criteria\n\n%s\n' "$criterion"
+    } > "$g/sprint.md"
+    local prmd="$ws/pr/PR.md" rcfx
+    if [[ ! -f "$prmd" ]]; then
+      rcfx="$(yq -r '.review_catch.fixture // ""' "$task")"
+      case "$rcfx" in *..*|/*) rcfx="" ;; esac
+      prmd="$_SM_REPO_ROOT/evals/fixtures/$rcfx/PR.md"
+    fi
+    [[ -f "$prmd" ]] || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: no PR.md for review-catch task $tid"; return 2; }
+    { printf '# Implementation Report: %s\n\n' "$label"; cat "$prmd"; } > "$g/a2a/$label/reviewer.md"
+    wrote="$wrote sprint.md a2a/$label/reviewer.md"
+  fi
+  _sm_evidence grimoire "$wrote"
+  return 0
+}

+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+init_sandbox_beads() {
+  local ws="$1" title="${2:-}"
+  [[ -d "$ws" ]] || { _sm_err "init_sandbox_beads: workspace not found: $ws"; return 2; }
+  [[ -n "$title" ]] || title="eval task"
+  local br="${LOA_EVAL_BR_BIN:-br}"
+  if command -v "$br" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+    ( cd "$ws" && "$br" init --prefix bd --no-daemon >/dev/null 2>&1 && "$br" create "$title" --type task --silent >/dev/null 2>&1 ) \
+      || { _sm_err "init_sandbox_beads: br init/create failed in $ws"; return 2; }
+    _sm_evidence beads "br"
+    return 0
+  fi
+  local ubs="$ws/.claude/scripts/beads/update-beads-state.sh"
+  if [[ -f "$ubs" ]]; then
+    PROJECT_ROOT="$ws" bash "$ubs" --opt-out "eval sandbox: br not on PATH" >/dev/null 2>&1 \
+      || { _sm_err "init_sandbox_beads: update-beads-state.sh --opt-out failed"; return 2; }
+    _sm_evidence beads "opt-out"
+    return 0
+  fi
+  _sm_evidence beads "none"
+  return 0
+}

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# =============================================================================
+# evals/harness/lib/sandbox-mount.sh — sandbox materialisation and arm toggles
+#
+# cycle-130 Sprint 258 Task 1.6 (SDD D-4.5, DEC-0421, DEC-0423, DEC-0396).
+# Extracted from execute-agent.sh (cycle-129 step 2 and the toggle functions)
+# WITHOUT behaviour change for the cycle-129 single-skill path, and shared with
+# pipeline-run.sh. Source it; it defines functions only and sets no shell
+# options (the caller runs under `set -euo pipefail`).
+#
+# Contract (every function returns 0 on success, 2 when refused / when a step
+# cannot take effect; refusals name the reason on one stderr line):
+#
+#   mount_prompt_surface <ws> <prompt_tree> <skill|->
+#       skill given: <ws>/.claude/skills/<skill>/ (whole dir), .claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md,
+#       .claude/rules/, CLAUDE.md = "@.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md"; the prompt tree's
+#       .loa.config.yaml only in arm mode (LOA_EVAL_ARM set), as cycle-129 did.
+#       skill "-": the whole .claude/ tree is copied (files, never a symlink to the
+#       tree), CLAUDE.md as above, and .loa.config.yaml always (the pipeline
+#       executor needs every skill, hook and script). Evidence: mount=skill:<s>|tree.
+#   resolve_arm_toggles <arm> <suite_file>
+#       prints the arm's toggles as compact JSON on stdout. Arms are read from
+#       `.arms[]` (ablation-2.0) and `.ab.arms[]` (recall suites). An arm with
+#       toggles {} (a1_full, baseline) prints {}; `baseline` undeclared prints {}.
+#       Exit 2: undeclared arm (an unreadable suite file declares none), `absent: true` arm.
+#   apply_arm_toggles <ws> <toggles_json> <arm>
+#       applies every toggle to the SANDBOX COPY and verifies it afterwards; exit 2
+#       when one cannot take effect or is unknown. Toggles and values:
+#         companion_voice: false  flatline_protocol.{code_review,security_audit}.companion_voice=false
+#         karpathy_block: false   '## Karpathy Principles' out of CLAUDE.loa.md (+ constraints.json rows)
+#         rule_files: false       stash-safety.md, skill-invariants.md out of .claude/rules/
+#         audit_delta_instruction: false  the delta paragraph out of auditing-security/SKILL.md
+#         loa_mount: false        verifies no .claude/, CLAUDE.md, .loa.config.yaml in <ws>
+#                                 (the caller skips mount_prompt_surface); evidence loa_mount=none
+#         effort: low|medium|high|xhigh|max
+#                                 every `effort:` line out of the frontmatter of every
+#                                 <ws>/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md; every `default_effort` key in
+#                                 <ws>/.claude/defaults/model-config.yaml set to the value and its
+#                                 .checksum (bare sha256 hex) refreshed when present.
+#                                 The caller passes `--effort <v>` on argv.
+#         gates: false            flatline_protocol.{code_review,security_audit}.enabled=false;
+#                                 LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false exported in the CALLING shell
+#                                 and written to $ARM_ENV_FILE (KEY=VALUE lines) when that is set
+#         flatline: false         flatline_protocol.enabled=false
+#         sprint_plan: false, context_resets: false
+#                                 phase-set edits owned by the pipeline executor; recorded as
+#                                 evidence here (the single-skill executor refuses them itself)
+#   regen_sandbox_manifest <ws>
+#       writes <ws>/.claude/checksums.json {generated, algorithm: sha256, files} over
+#       every regular file under <ws>/.claude except overrides/ and the manifest
+#       itself (LC_ALL=C order, sha256). tools/gen-checksums.sh (in the
+#       prompt tree, $EVAL_PROMPT_TREE) is used instead when it exists AND <ws> is a
+#       git repository tracking .claude files (it lists `git ls-files`). No .claude/
+#       (loa_mount: false) → manifest_sha256=none, exit 0. Prints manifest_sha256=<hex>.
+#   check_fixture_path_rule <fixture_dir>
+#       exit 2 (offending paths on stderr) when the fixture's top level holds
+#       .claude, CLAUDE.md, .loa.config.yaml, grimoires or .run — the mount owns
+#       those paths (DEC-0396); exit 0 otherwise.
+#   write_sandbox_grimoire <ws> <task_yaml> <arm> <sprint_label>
+#       grimoires/loa/ledger.json (one active cycle, <sprint_label> planned, global 1;
+#       the ledger-lib.sh schema), NOTES.md (header only), context/task-brief.md (the
+#       task's agent-facing `criterion` + the TASK.md next to task.yaml),
+#       a2a/<sprint_label>/ (empty); review-catch tasks also get a one-sprint
+#       grimoires/loa/sprint.md naming pr/head.diff and a2a/<sprint_label>/reviewer.md
+#       carrying pr/PR.md (sandbox copy, else the corpus fixture's). An arm whose
+#       toggles carry sprint_plan: false (resolved from $LOA_EVAL_SUITE_FILE, default
+#       evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml) gets NO sprint.md. Build tasks leave sprint.md
+#       to the PLAN phase. Nothing written names the arm.
+#   init_sandbox_beads <ws> <task_title>
+#       `br init --prefix bd --no-daemon` in <ws> plus one task bead with the title
+#       when br ($LOA_EVAL_BR_BIN, default br) is on PATH → beads=br; else the opt-out
+#       marker through <ws>/.claude/scripts/beads/update-beads-state.sh --opt-out →
+#       beads=opt-out; neither → beads=none (exit 0).
+#
+# Hashing is Python hashlib (_sm_sha256), never .claude/ code: see _sm_sha256.
+# Callers source this file by a literal relative path (no variable expansion
+# on the source line), as eval.yml's trust-boundary scan requires.
+#
+# Evidence: every function reports `key=value` lines (one line, no newline in
+# the value). When ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE is set they are appended to that file;
+# else they go to the descriptor in SANDBOX_MOUNT_EVIDENCE_FD (default 1).
+# resolve_arm_toggles prints JSON on stdout and no evidence.
+#
+# Tested by evals/tests/arm-toggles.bats (directly and through execute-agent.sh)
+# and evals/tests/execute-agent.bats.
+# =============================================================================
+
+[[ "${_SANDBOX_MOUNT_LOADED:-}" == "true" ]] && return 0
+_SANDBOX_MOUNT_LOADED=true
+
+_SM_LIB_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
+_SM_REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$_SM_LIB_DIR/../../.." && pwd)"
+
+_sm_err() { echo "ERROR: $*" >&2; }
+
+# _sm_sha256 <file>... prints "<hex>  <file>" lines, the sha256sum output shape.
+# Python hashlib, not compat-lib's sha256_portable: the eval workflow runs the
+# harness as the trusted copy against a PR's .claude/, so no harness script
+# sources .claude/ code (eval.yml "Validate grader trust boundary"); run-arms.sh
+# hashes the corpus the same way.
+_sm_sha256() {
+  python3 -I -c '
+import hashlib, sys
+for p in sys.argv[1:]:
+    h = hashlib.sha256()
+    with open(p, "rb") as f:
+        for b in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
+            h.update(b)
+    print(h.hexdigest() + "  " + p)' "$@"
+}
+
+# _sm_evidence <key> <value> — one key=value line to the evidence sink.
+_sm_evidence() {
+  local line="$1=${2//$'\n'/ }"
+  if [[ -n "${ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE:-}" ]]; then
+    printf '%s\n' "$line" >> "$ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE"
+  else
+    local fd="${SANDBOX_MOUNT_EVIDENCE_FD:-1}"
+    [[ "$fd" =~ ^[0-9]$ ]] || fd=1
+    printf '%s\n' "$line" >&"$fd"
+  fi
+}

+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+mount_prompt_surface() {
+  local ws="$1" tree="$2" skill="${3:-}"
+  [[ -d "$ws" ]] || { _sm_err "mount_prompt_surface: workspace not found: $ws"; return 2; }
+  [[ -d "$tree/.claude" ]] || { _sm_err "mount_prompt_surface: prompt tree has no .claude/: $tree"; return 2; }
+  if [[ "$skill" == "-" ]]; then
+    mkdir -p "$ws/.claude"
+    cp -a "$tree/.claude/." "$ws/.claude/" || { _sm_err "mount_prompt_surface: copying .claude/ failed"; return 2; }
+    printf '@.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md\n' > "$ws/CLAUDE.md"
+    if [[ -f "$tree/.loa.config.yaml" ]]; then cp "$tree/.loa.config.yaml" "$ws/.loa.config.yaml"; fi
+    _sm_evidence mount "tree"
+    return 0
+  fi
+  case "$skill" in */*|.*|'') _sm_err "invalid skill name '$skill'"; return 2 ;; esac
+  local skill_src="$tree/.claude/skills/$skill"
+  [[ -f "$skill_src/SKILL.md" ]] || { _sm_err "prompt tree $tree has no .claude/skills/$skill/SKILL.md"; return 2; }
+  mkdir -p "$ws/.claude/skills" "$ws/.claude/loa"
+  # Whole skill dir (resources included) so guarded reads inside the skill resolve.
+  local skill_dst="$ws/.claude/skills/$skill"
+  mkdir -p "$skill_dst"
+  cp -a "$skill_src/." "$skill_dst/"
+  if [[ -f "$tree/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md" ]]; then
+    cp "$tree/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md" "$ws/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md"
+  fi
+  if [[ -d "$tree/.claude/rules" ]]; then
+    mkdir -p "$ws/.claude/rules"
+    cp -a "$tree/.claude/rules/." "$ws/.claude/rules/"
+  fi
+  printf '@.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md\n' > "$ws/CLAUDE.md"
+  if [[ -n "${LOA_EVAL_ARM+x}" && -f "$tree/.loa.config.yaml" ]]; then
+    cp "$tree/.loa.config.yaml" "$ws/.loa.config.yaml"
+  fi
+  _sm_evidence mount "skill:$skill"
+  return 0
+}

+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+resolve_arm_toggles() {
+  local arm="$1" suite_file="${2:-}"
+  [[ "$arm" =~ ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$ ]] || { _sm_err "invalid arm id '$arm'"; return 2; }
+  local found=0 entry=""
+  if [[ -n "$suite_file" && -f "$suite_file" ]]; then
+    # an unreadable suite file reads as "not declared" (cycle-129 behaviour: baseline still resolves to {})
+    entry="$(ARM="$arm" yq -o=json -I=0 '[((.arms // [])[]), ((.ab.arms // [])[])] | map(select(.id == strenv(ARM))) | .[0] // null' "$suite_file" 2>/dev/null)" \
+      || entry=""
+    [[ -n "$entry" && "$entry" != "null" ]] && found=1
+  fi
+  if [[ "$found" -eq 0 ]]; then
+    [[ "$arm" == "baseline" ]] && { printf '{}'; return 0; }
+    _sm_err "arm '$arm' is not declared in ${suite_file:-any suite} (arms[] / ab.arms[])"
+    return 2
+  fi
+  if [[ "$(jq -r '.absent // false' <<<"$entry")" == "true" ]]; then
+    _sm_err "arm '$arm' is declared absent in $suite_file (never run): $(jq -r '.evidence // "no evidence"' <<<"$entry")"
+    return 2
+  fi
+  local t
+  t="$(jq -c '.toggles // {}' <<<"$entry")"
+  jq -e 'type == "object"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$t" || { _sm_err "arm '$arm' toggles are not an object in $suite_file"; return 2; }
+  printf '%s' "$t"
+}

+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Remove the markdown section that starts at the exact heading line $2 (up to
+# the next level-2 heading) from file $1. Prints the number of lines removed.
+_sm_drop_md_section() {
+  local f="$1" heading="$2" tmpdir="$3" tmp
+  tmp="$(mktemp "$tmpdir/.arm.XXXXXX")"
+  awk -v h="$heading" '
+    $0 == h { skip = 1; n++; next }
+    skip && /^## / { skip = 0 }
+    skip { n++; next }
+    { print }
+    END { print n + 0 > "/dev/stderr" }' "$f" > "$tmp" 2> "$tmp.n"
+  mv "$tmp" "$f"
+  cat "$tmp.n"; rm -f "$tmp.n"
+}
+
+# Remove the first blank-line-delimited paragraph of $1 that contains one of
+# the needles (tried in order, case-insensitive). Writes the removed text to
+# $2; exit 1 when no needle matches.
+_sm_drop_paragraph() {
+  python3 -I - "$1" "$2" "look for what the review did not" "Confirm the review's demotions independently" <<'PY'
+import re, sys
+path, out = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
+text = open(path, encoding="utf-8").read()
+paras = re.split(r"(\n[ \t]*\n)", text)
+for needle in sys.argv[3:]:
+    for i in range(0, len(paras), 2):
+        if needle.lower() in paras[i].lower():
+            removed = paras[i]
+            # drop the paragraph and the separator that follows it
+            del paras[i:i + 2]
+            open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8").write("".join(paras))
+            open(out, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(removed + "\n")
+            sys.exit(0)
+sys.exit(1)
+PY
+}
+
+# Strip every `effort:` line from the YAML frontmatter of file $1 (frontmatter
+# = line 1 `---` up to the next `---`). Prints 1 when a line was removed, else 0.
+_sm_strip_frontmatter_effort() {
+  local f="$1" tmp
+  tmp="$(mktemp "$f.XXXXXX")"
+  awk '
+    NR == 1 && $0 == "---" { fm = 1; print; next }
+    fm == 1 && $0 == "---" { fm = 2; print; next }
+    fm == 1 && /^effort:/ { n++; next }
+    { print }
+    END { print (n > 0 ? 1 : 0) > "/dev/stderr" }' "$f" > "$tmp" 2> "$tmp.n"
+  cat "$tmp" > "$f"; rm -f "$tmp"
+  cat "$tmp.n"; rm -f "$tmp.n"
+}
+
+# 0 when file $1's frontmatter still carries an `effort:` line.
+_sm_frontmatter_has_effort() {
+  awk 'NR == 1 && $0 != "---" { exit 1 } NR > 1 && $0 == "---" { exit 1 } NR > 1 && /^effort:/ { found = 1; exit 0 } END { exit (found ? 0 : 1) }' "$1"
+}
+
+_sm_cfg_set_false() {  # _sm_cfg_set_false <cfg> <yq-path>... ; verifies each
+  local cfg="$1"; shift
+  [[ -f "$cfg" ]] || : > "$cfg"
+  local p
+  for p in "$@"; do
+    P="$p" yq -i 'eval(strenv(P)) = false' "$cfg" 2>/dev/null || return 1
+    [[ "$(P="$p" yq -r 'eval(strenv(P))' "$cfg" 2>/dev/null)" == "false" ]] || return 1
+  done
+  return 0
+}

+apply_arm_toggles() {
+  local ws="$1" toggles="${2:-}" arm="${3:-}"
+  [[ -d "$ws" ]] || { _sm_err "apply_arm_toggles: workspace not found: $ws"; return 2; }
+  [[ -n "$toggles" ]] || toggles='{}'
+  jq -e 'type == "object"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$toggles" || { _sm_err "arm '$arm' toggles are not a JSON object"; return 2; }
+  local eval_dir="$ws/.eval"
+  mkdir -p "$eval_dir"
+  local key val
+  while IFS=$'\t' read -r key val; do
+    [[ -n "$key" ]] || continue
+    if [[ "$key" == "effort" ]]; then
+      case "$val" in low|medium|high|xhigh|max) ;; *) _sm_err "arm '$arm' toggle effort=$val (want low|medium|high|xhigh|max)"; return 2 ;; esac
+    elif [[ "$val" != "false" ]]; then
+      _sm_err "arm '$arm' toggle $key=$val (only false is defined)"; return 2
+    fi
+    case "$key" in
+      companion_voice)
+        _sm_cfg_set_false "$ws/.loa.config.yaml" .flatline_protocol.code_review.companion_voice .flatline_protocol.security_audit.companion_voice \
+          || { _sm_err "companion_voice toggle did not take effect"; return 2; }
+        _sm_evidence companion_voice "flatline_protocol.{code_review,security_audit}.companion_voice=false"
+        ;;
+      karpathy_block)
+        local k="$ws/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md" n
+        [[ -f "$k" ]] || { _sm_err "karpathy_block toggle: no sandbox CLAUDE.loa.md"; return 2; }
+        n="$(_sm_drop_md_section "$k" '## Karpathy Principles' "$eval_dir")"
+        if [[ "${n:-0}" -eq 0 ]] || grep -q '^## Karpathy Principles' "$k"; then
+          _sm_err "karpathy_block toggle: no '## Karpathy Principles' section removed"; return 2
+        fi
+        local cj="$ws/.claude/data/constraints.json" cjn="none"
+        if [[ -f "$cj" ]]; then
+          # audit r1 DISS-C-008: a failed rewrite is exit 2, not a silent pass; verify afterwards
+          jq '(.constraints // []) |= map(select((tostring | test("karpathy"; "i")) | not))' "$cj" > "$cj.tmp" \
+            || { rm -f "$cj.tmp"; _sm_err "karpathy_block toggle: constraints.json could not be rewritten"; return 2; }
+          mv "$cj.tmp" "$cj"
+          cjn="$(jq '[(.constraints // [])[] | select(tostring | test("karpathy"; "i"))] | length' "$cj" 2>/dev/null || echo "?")"
+          [[ "$cjn" == "0" ]] || { _sm_err "karpathy_block toggle: constraints.json still carries Karpathy rows ($cjn)"; return 2; }
+        fi
+        _sm_evidence karpathy_block "removed ${n} lines from CLAUDE.loa.md; constraints.json karpathy rows after: ${cjn}"
+        ;;
+      rule_files)
+        local r gone=""
+        for r in stash-safety.md skill-invariants.md; do
+          if [[ -e "$ws/.claude/rules/$r" ]]; then rm -f "$ws/.claude/rules/$r"; gone="$gone $r"; fi
+          [[ ! -e "$ws/.claude/rules/$r" ]] || { _sm_err "rule_files toggle: $r still present"; return 2; }
+        done
+        _sm_evidence rule_files "removed:${gone:- none present}"
+        ;;
+      audit_delta_instruction)
+        local s="$ws/.claude/skills/auditing-security/SKILL.md"
+        [[ -f "$s" ]] || { _sm_err "audit_delta_instruction toggle: no sandbox auditing-security/SKILL.md"; return 2; }
+        _sm_drop_paragraph "$s" "$eval_dir/arm-removed.txt" \
+          || { _sm_err "audit_delta_instruction toggle: no delta paragraph found in the sandbox SKILL.md"; return 2; }
+        _sm_evidence audit_delta_instruction "removed $(wc -c < "$eval_dir/arm-removed.txt" | tr -d ' ') bytes (.eval/arm-removed.txt)"
+        ;;
+      loa_mount)
+        local p left=""
+        for p in .claude CLAUDE.md .loa.config.yaml; do
+          if [[ -e "$ws/$p" || -L "$ws/$p" ]]; then left="$left $p"; fi
+        done
+        [[ -z "$left" ]] || { _sm_err "loa_mount toggle: the sandbox still holds:$left (mount_prompt_surface must be skipped)"; return 2; }
+        _sm_evidence loa_mount "none"
+        ;;
+      effort)
+        local f total=0 stripped=0 still=""
+        for f in "$ws"/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md; do
+          [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue
+          total=$((total + 1))
+          if [[ "$(_sm_strip_frontmatter_effort "$f")" == "1" ]]; then stripped=$((stripped + 1)); fi
+          if _sm_frontmatter_has_effort "$f"; then still="$still ${f#"$ws"/}"; fi
+        done
+        [[ -z "$still" ]] || { _sm_err "effort toggle: effort: still in the frontmatter of:$still"; return 2; }
+        local mc="$ws/.claude/defaults/model-config.yaml" cat_state="absent"
+        if [[ -f "$mc" ]]; then
+          local nkeys
+          nkeys="$(yq '[.. | select(tag == "!!map" and has("default_effort"))] | length' "$mc" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
+          [[ "$nkeys" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && "$nkeys" -gt 0 ]] \
+            || { _sm_err "effort toggle: no default_effort key in the sandbox model-config.yaml"; return 2; }
+          V="$val" yq -i '(.. | select(tag == "!!map" and has("default_effort")) | .default_effort) = strenv(V)' "$mc" \
+            || { _sm_err "effort toggle: yq failed on the sandbox model-config.yaml"; return 2; }
+          local wrong
+          wrong="$(V="$val" yq '[.. | select(tag == "!!map" and has("default_effort")) | select(.default_effort != strenv(V))] | length' "$mc" 2>/dev/null || echo 1)"
+          [[ "$wrong" == "0" ]] || { _sm_err "effort toggle: default_effort did not take effect"; return 2; }
+          cat_state="default_effort=$val in $nkeys entries"
+          if [[ -f "$mc.checksum" ]]; then
+            local h
+            h="$(_sm_sha256 "$mc" | awk '{print $1}')"
+            [[ "$h" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]] || { _sm_err "effort toggle: could not hash model-config.yaml"; return 2; }
+            printf '%s\n' "$h" > "$mc.checksum"
+            cat_state="$cat_state; .checksum refreshed"
+          fi
+        fi
+        _sm_evidence effort "$val"
+        _sm_evidence effort_skills_stripped "$stripped/$total"
+        _sm_evidence effort_catalog "$cat_state"
+        ;;
+      gates)
+        _sm_cfg_set_false "$ws/.loa.config.yaml" .flatline_protocol.code_review.enabled .flatline_protocol.security_audit.enabled \
+          || { _sm_err "gates toggle did not take effect"; return 2; }
+        export LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false
+        if [[ -n "${ARM_ENV_FILE:-}" ]]; then printf 'LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false\n' >> "$ARM_ENV_FILE"; fi
+        _sm_evidence gates "flatline_protocol.{code_review,security_audit}.enabled=false"
+        _sm_evidence arm_env "LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false"
+        ;;
+      flatline)
+        _sm_cfg_set_false "$ws/.loa.config.yaml" .flatline_protocol.enabled \
+          || { _sm_err "flatline toggle did not take effect"; return 2; }
+        _sm_evidence flatline "flatline_protocol.enabled=false"
+        ;;
+      sprint_plan)
+        _sm_evidence sprint_plan "phase set without PLAN (pipeline executor); no sprint.md materialised"
+        ;;
+      context_resets)
+        _sm_evidence context_resets "implementer phases continue one session (pipeline executor)"
+        ;;
+      *) _sm_err "arm '$arm' declares unknown toggle '$key'"; return 2 ;;
+    esac
+  done < <(jq -r 'to_entries[] | [.key, (.value | tostring)] | @tsv' <<<"$toggles")
+  return 0
+}

+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+regen_sandbox_manifest() {
+  local ws="$1"
+  [[ -d "$ws" ]] || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: workspace not found: $ws"; return 2; }
+  if [[ ! -d "$ws/.claude" ]]; then
+    _sm_evidence manifest_sha256 "none"
+    return 0
+  fi
+  local out="$ws/.claude/checksums.json" tool="${EVAL_PROMPT_TREE:-$_SM_REPO_ROOT}/tools/gen-checksums.sh" how="inline"
+  if [[ -x "$tool" ]] && git -C "$ws" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 \
+     && [[ -n "$(git -C "$ws" ls-files .claude 2>/dev/null | head -1)" ]]; then
+    "$tool" --root "$ws" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: $tool --root $ws failed"; return 2; }
+    how="gen-checksums.sh"
+  else
+    local list="$ws/.eval/.manifest-files" sums="$ws/.eval/.manifest-sums"
+    mkdir -p "$ws/.eval"
+    ( cd "$ws" && find .claude -type f ! -path '.claude/overrides/*' ! -path '.claude/checksums.json' -print ) \
+      | LC_ALL=C sort > "$list"
+    if grep -q '\\' "$list"; then _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: a path under .claude/ holds a backslash"; rm -f "$list"; return 2; fi
+    : > "$sums"
+    local -a batch=()
+    local f
+    while IFS= read -r f; do
+      batch+=("$f")
+      if [[ ${#batch[@]} -ge 200 ]]; then
+        ( cd "$ws" && _sm_sha256 "${batch[@]}" ) >> "$sums" || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: hashing failed"; return 2; }
+        batch=()
+      fi
+    done < "$list"
+    if [[ ${#batch[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
+      ( cd "$ws" && _sm_sha256 "${batch[@]}" ) >> "$sums" || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: hashing failed"; return 2; }
+    fi
+    jq -Rn --arg generated "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" '
+      {generated: $generated, algorithm: "sha256",
+       files: ([inputs | select(length > 0) | capture("^(?<h>[0-9a-f]{64})  (?<p>.+)$") | {key: .p, value: .h}] | from_entries)}' \
+      < "$sums" > "$out.tmp" || { rm -f "$out.tmp" "$list" "$sums"; _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: could not write the manifest"; return 2; }
+    mv "$out.tmp" "$out"
+    rm -f "$list" "$sums"
+  fi
+  jq -e '.files | type == "object"' "$out" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: $out is not a manifest"; return 2; }
+  local digest
+  digest="$(_sm_sha256 "$out" | awk '{print $1}')"
+  _sm_evidence manifest_files "$(jq '.files | length' "$out") ($how)"
+  _sm_evidence manifest_sha256 "$digest"
+  return 0
+}

+write_sandbox_grimoire() {
+  local ws="$1" task="$2" arm="$3" label="${4:-sprint-1}"
+  [[ -d "$ws" ]] || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: workspace not found: $ws"; return 2; }
+  [[ -f "$task" ]] || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: task yaml not found: $task"; return 2; }
+  [[ "$label" =~ ^sprint-[0-9]{1,4}$ ]] || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: invalid sprint label '$label'"; return 2; }
+  local tid ttype criterion task_md
+  tid="$(yq -r '.id // ""' "$task")"; ttype="$(yq -r '.type // ""' "$task")"
+  criterion="$(yq -r '.criterion // ""' "$task")"
+  [[ "$tid" =~ ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,63}$ ]] || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: task id '$tid' invalid"; return 2; }
+  [[ -n "$criterion" && "$criterion" != "null" ]] || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: task $tid has no criterion"; return 2; }
+  task_md="$(dirname "$task")/TASK.md"
+  [[ -f "$task_md" ]] || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: no TASK.md beside $task"; return 2; }
+
+  local sprint_plan=true
+  if [[ -n "$arm" ]]; then
+    local sf="${LOA_EVAL_SUITE_FILE:-$_SM_REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml}" tg
+    if tg="$(resolve_arm_toggles "$arm" "$sf" 2>/dev/null)"; then
+      [[ "$(jq -r 'if has("sprint_plan") then (.sprint_plan | tostring) else "true" end' <<<"$tg")" == "false" ]] && sprint_plan=false
+    fi
+  fi
+
+  local g="$ws/grimoires/loa" now
+  now="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
+  mkdir -p "$g/context" "$g/a2a/$label"
+  jq -n --arg now "$now" --arg label "$label" --arg tid "$tid" '
+    {version: 1, schema_version: 1, created: $now, last_updated: $now,
+     next_sprint_number: 2, global_sprint_counter: 1, active_cycle: "cycle-001",
+     cycles: [{id: "cycle-001", label: ("eval task " + $tid), status: "active", created: $now,
+               archived: null, archive_path: null, prd: null, sdd: null,
+               sprints: [{global_id: 1, local_label: $label, status: "planned", created: $now, completed: null}]}],
+     bugfixes: [], bugfix_cycles: []}' > "$g/ledger.json" \
+    || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: ledger write failed"; return 2; }
+  printf '# NOTES\n' > "$g/NOTES.md"
+  {
+    printf '# Task brief\n\n## Criterion\n\n%s\n\n## Task\n\n' "$criterion"
+    cat "$task_md"
+  } > "$g/context/task-brief.md"
+  local wrote="ledger.json NOTES.md context/task-brief.md a2a/$label/"
+
+  if [[ "$ttype" == "review-catch" && "$sprint_plan" == "true" ]]; then
+    {
+      printf '# Sprint Plan\n\n## Sprint %s: Review the pull request in pr/\n\n' "${label#sprint-}"
+      printf 'The change under review is `pr/head.diff` (unified diff, base to head). The files before the change are under `pr/base/`, after it under `pr/head/`; `pr/PR.md` is the pull request description and is the implementation report for this sprint.\n\n'

+      printf '## Success Criteria\n\n%s\n' "$criterion"
+    } > "$g/sprint.md"

+    wrote="$wrote sprint.md a2a/$label/reviewer.md"
+  fi
+  _sm_evidence grimoire "$wrote"
+  return 0
+}
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+init_sandbox_beads() {
+  local ws="$1" title="${2:-}"
+  [[ -d "$ws" ]] || { _sm_err "init_sandbox_beads: workspace not found: $ws"; return 2; }
+  [[ -n "$title" ]] || title="eval task"
+  local br="${LOA_EVAL_BR_BIN:-br}"
+  if command -v "$br" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+    ( cd "$ws" && "$br" init --prefix bd --no-daemon >/dev/null 2>&1 && "$br" create "$title" --type task --silent >/dev/null 2>&1 ) \
+      || { _sm_err "init_sandbox_beads: br init/create failed in $ws"; return 2; }
+    _sm_evidence beads "br"
+    return 0
+  fi
+  local ubs="$ws/.claude/scripts/beads/update-beads-state.sh"
+  if [[ -f "$ubs" ]]; then
+    PROJECT_ROOT="$ws" bash "$ubs" --opt-out "eval sandbox: br not on PATH" >/dev/null 2>&1 \
+      || { _sm_err "init_sandbox_beads: update-beads-state.sh --opt-out failed"; return 2; }
+    _sm_evidence beads "opt-out"
+    return 0
+  fi
+  _sm_evidence beads "none"
+  return 0
+}

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# =============================================================================
+# pipeline-run.sh — the cycle-130 ablation pipeline executor (SDD §1.4 D-4.1 … D-4.10, §5.6)
+#
+# Runs ONE task under ONE arm: materialises a sandbox repository (the task's
+# fixture tree, or the review-catch PR under pr/, plus the Loa mount from the
+# pinned --source-tree), then drives Loa's phases as separate `claude -p`
+# sessions inside it, records every phase, enforces the per-run cap and writes
+# meta/pipeline.json. One executor serves every task type (D-4.1):
+#   review-catch                      REVIEW → AUDIT
+#   bug-fix | refactor | feature-build PLAN → IMPLEMENT → REVIEW → FIX? → AUDIT → FIX?
+# A FIX runs only when the gate before it wrote a CHANGES_REQUIRED LOA-VERDICT
+# trailer (the last `<!-- LOA-VERDICT {…} -->` line of
+# grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/engineer-feedback.md resp. auditor-sprint-feedback.md);
+# a FIX that does not run is recorded `skipped: true`.
+# Arms edit the phase set (D-4.2): `sprint_plan: false` drops PLAN; `gates: false`
+# ends after IMPLEMENT; `loa_mount: false` runs one BARE session (no mount);
+# `flatline: false` keeps PLAN with the Flatline step off; `context_resets: false`
+# runs PLAN, IMPLEMENT and FIX as ONE implementer session (`--resume <session_id>`
+# from the first session's system/init event) while REVIEW and AUDIT stay separate.
+# The suite's `phase_sets[<review-catch|build>]` and an arm's `phases` override the
+# default phase list; the toggle edits above apply on top.
+#
+# Usage:
+#   pipeline-run.sh --task-yaml F --arm ID --run-dir D --run-id R --trial N \
+#                   --source-tree DIR --suite-file F [--max-run-usd 12] \
+#                   [--executor container|host] [--image IMG] [--claude-bin B] \
+#                   [--docker-bin D] [--phase-models JSON] [--phase-timeouts JSON] [--dry-run]
+#
+# Options:
+#   --task-yaml F       task.yaml (SDD §3.2); its directory holds TASK.md
+#   --arm ID            arm id declared in the suite file (`arms[].id`)
+#   --run-dir D         run directory to create (must not exist or be empty);
+#                       alias --workspace
+#   --run-id R          run id recorded in pipeline.json
+#   --trial N           trial number
+#   --source-tree DIR   the pinned Loa tree the mount is copied from
+#   --suite-file F      evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml (read with yq -o=json)
+#   --max-run-usd USD   per-run cap (default 12; config evals.ablation.run_cap_usd)
+#   --executor MODE     container (default; DEC-0411) or host
+#   --image IMG         container image (default loa-ablation:258)
+#   --claude-bin B      host-mode CLI (default $EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN, else claude)
+#   --docker-bin D      docker CLI (default $EVAL_DOCKER_BIN, else docker)
+#   --phase-models JSON {"PLAN": "<model id>", …} override ($LOA_EVAL_PHASE_MODELS)
+#   --phase-timeouts JSON {"IMPLEMENT": <seconds>, …} override
+#   --dry-run           print the phase plan and exit 0; nothing is created
+#
+# Run directory layout (DEC-0413 — the grader never reads meta/):
+#   sandbox/     the agent's tree (its own .git initialised at `base`)
+#   snapshots/   <label>.bundle + index.json ({IMPLEMENT|FIX1|FIX2: commit}) after
+#                IMPLEMENT and each FIX
+#   transcripts/ events-<label>.jsonl (stream-json), stderr-<label>.log
+#   eval/        model-invoke.jsonl, cost-ledger.jsonl (copied out of
+#                sandbox/.eval/ after every phase), adversarial-*.json
+#   meta/        pipeline.json, phase-<label>.argv.json (argv + captured env),
+#                prompt-<label>.md, arm, arm-evidence.txt, arm-env, refused.json,
+#                home/ (container mode: the per-run HOME; deleted at exit)
+#
+# Session (D-4.3, DEC-0394 as amended, DEC-0412): `claude -p <prompt> --output-format
+# stream-json --verbose --model <id> --permission-mode bypassPermissions
+# --dangerously-skip-permissions --setting-sources project --tools <list>
+# --max-turns <cap> [--effort <v>] [--resume <id>]`, cwd sandbox/, with exactly this
+# environment: PATH HOME LANG LC_ALL TERM TMPDIR CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK
+# CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL LOA_MODELINV_LOG_PATH LOA_COST_LEDGER_PATH
+# GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GH_CONFIG_DIR=<sandbox/.eval/gh-empty>,
+# the Bedrock route's pass-through keys when set in the driver's environment
+# (AWS_REGION AWS_DEFAULT_REGION AWS_PROFILE AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK
+# ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_REGION_PREFIX ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_{OPUS,SONNET,HAIKU}_MODEL), and the
+# arm's LOA_* variables (LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false for gates: false).
+# A python3 -I exec shim closes every descriptor above 2 and keeps exactly those keys;
+# values reach it through the environment, never argv, so AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK
+# appears in no argv, capture or log (phase-<label>.argv.json records it as "<set>").
+# `timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=15` bounds the CLI.
+# Container mode (D-4.9, DEC-0411 as amended) runs the same command inside
+#   docker run --rm --name <n> --user <uid>:<gid> --network bridge --read-only
+#     --tmpfs /tmp:rw,size=1g --pids-limit 512 --memory 4g --cpus 2
+#     -v <run>/sandbox:/workspace:rw -v <run>/meta/home:/home/evaluser:rw
+#     -w /workspace -e <KEY=value…> -e AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK <image> python3 -I -c <shim> … claude …
+# Exactly two mounts. meta/home/ (mode 0700) holds copies of $HOME/.codex/{auth.json,
+# config.toml} when present and empty .claude/ and .aws/; the CLI's session store
+# lives there for the whole run, so A6's --resume works across phases. No ~/.claude
+# file is ever copied. The directory is deleted at exit and on interrupt.
+# image_digest = the image's RepoDigest or id (container), else the fingerprint (host).
+# Versions: `fingerprint` is computed from the HOST toolchain; in container mode the
+# toolchain that runs the phases is the image's (Claude Code 2.1.299, codex 0.137.0 by
+# Dockerfile.ablation), so image_digest identifies the batch's versions. On 2026-10-15
+# the host CLI was 2.1.300 while the image pins 2.1.299; every arm runs in the container.
+#
+# Cap and watchdog (D-4.6, D-4.10): while a phase runs the driver re-prices the
+# stream's assistant-turn usage every $LOA_EVAL_WATCHDOG_POLL_S seconds (default 1)
+# from per-token prices fetched once per model (pricing.py; $LOA_EVAL_PRICING_JSON
+# overrides) and SIGTERMs the phase when spent + estimate ≥ the cap (cap_turn
+# recorded). After each phase the result's total_cost_usd (authoritative) plus the
+# sandbox cost-ledger rows written during the phase are added; ≥ cap → cap_failure.
+#
+# Exit codes:
+#   0  finished (any verdict)                                   status completed
+#   1  agent error: a phase exited non-zero or timed out        status agent_error
+#   2  infrastructure: usage, refused arm/type, mount/toggle failure, CLI/docker
+#      or image missing, fixture path rule, leak guard          status infrastructure_error
+#   3  cap failure (run stopped at the cap)                     status cap_failure
+#   4  interrupted (SIGTERM/SIGINT/SIGHUP to the driver, or a phase killed from
+#      outside)                                                 status interrupted
+# pipeline.json is written for every exit except usage errors and --dry-run; it is
+# rewritten with status `running` after each phase so a SIGKILLed driver leaves a
+# record (ablation-row.sh reads `running` as interrupted).
+#
+# Env: EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN, EVAL_DOCKER_BIN, LOA_EVAL_PHASE_MODELS, LOA_EVAL_PRICING_JSON,
+# LOA_EVAL_WATCHDOG_POLL_S, LOA_EVAL_CREDS_HOME (where ~/.codex is read; default $HOME),
+# LOA_EVAL_CONTAINER_CLAUDE_BIN (default claude), LOA_EVAL_EXECUTOR.
+#
+# Mount library: lib/sandbox-mount.sh beside this script, sourced by a literal path.
+# Exported to it: ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE, ARM_ENV_FILE (meta/arm-env), LOA_EVAL_SUITE_FILE.
+#
+# Tested by evals/tests/pipeline-run.bats (stub claude, stub docker, and a temporary
+# copy of this harness whose lib/sandbox-mount.sh is the stub mount library).
+# =============================================================================
+set -euo pipefail

+
+SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
+REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"

+MAX_RUN_USD="" EXECUTOR="${LOA_EVAL_EXECUTOR:-container}" IMAGE="loa-ablation:258"
+CLAUDE_BIN="${EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN:-claude}" DOCKER_BIN="${EVAL_DOCKER_BIN:-docker}"
+PHASE_MODELS_JSON="${LOA_EVAL_PHASE_MODELS:-}" PHASE_TIMEOUTS_JSON="" DRY_RUN=false
+SPRINT="sprint-1"
+TOOLS_DEFAULT="Bash,Read,Grep,Glob,Write,Edit,Task,WebFetch"
+
+die_usage() { echo "pipeline-run.sh: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
+while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
+  case "$1" in
+    --task-yaml)      TASK_YAML="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
+    --arm)            ARM="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
+    --run-dir|--workspace) RUN_DIR="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;

+    --docker-bin)     DOCKER_BIN="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;

+[[ -f "$SUITE_FILE" ]] || die_usage "suite file not found: $SUITE_FILE"

+  bug-fix|refactor|feature-build) KIND="build" ;;
+  *) die_usage "task type '$TASK_TYPE' is not one of feature-build|bug-fix|refactor|review-catch" ;;
+esac
+
+# --- arm and phase plan -------------------------------------------------------
+ARM_DEF="$(jq -c --arg a "$ARM" '[.arms // [] | .[] | select(.id == $a)][0] // empty' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"

+  REFUSAL="arm '$ARM' is not declared in the suite"
+elif [[ "$(jq -r '.absent // false' <<<"$ARM_DEF")" == "true" ]]; then
+  REFUSAL="arm '$ARM' is declared absent: true"
+elif ! jq -e --arg k "$KIND" --arg t "$TASK_TYPE" \

+phase_skill() {  # the Loa skill a phase invokes (for effort_requested)

+    PLAN) echo planning-sprints ;; IMPLEMENT|FIX) echo implementing-tasks ;;
+    REVIEW) echo reviewing-code ;; AUDIT) echo auditing-security ;; *) echo "" ;;

+builtin_model() { case "$1" in REVIEW|AUDIT) echo global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1 ;; *) echo global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5 ;; esac; }
+builtin_turns() { case "$1" in PLAN) echo 30 ;; IMPLEMENT) echo 60 ;; REVIEW|FIX|AUDIT) echo 40 ;; BARE) echo 170 ;; *) echo 40 ;; esac; }

+phase_model() {
+  jq -r --arg n "$1" --arg d "$(builtin_model "$1")" --argjson o "$PHASE_MODELS_JSON" \
+    '$o[$n] // .phase_defaults.models[$n] // $d' <<<"$SUITE_JSON"
+}
+phase_cap() {  # phase_cap <name> max_turns|timeout_min — task bounds > suite phase_defaults > built-in;
+               # BARE without a declaration = PLAN + IMPLEMENT + 2 × FIX
+  local n="$1" key="$2" v
+  v="$(jq -r --arg n "$n" --arg k "$key" '.bounds[$k][$n] // empty' <<<"$TASK_JSON")"
+  [[ -n "$v" ]] || v="$(jq -r --arg n "$n" --arg k "$key" '.phase_defaults[$k][$n] // empty' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
+  if [[ -z "$v" && "$n" == "BARE" ]]; then
+    v=$(( $(phase_cap PLAN "$key") + $(phase_cap IMPLEMENT "$key") + 2 * $(phase_cap FIX "$key") ))
+  fi
+  if [[ -z "$v" ]]; then
+    if [[ "$key" == max_turns ]]; then v="$(builtin_turns "$n")"; else v="$(builtin_tmin "$n")"; fi
+  fi
+  printf '%s' "$v"
+}
+phase_timeout_s() {
+  local o; o="$(jq -r --arg n "$1" '.[$n] // empty' <<<"$PHASE_TIMEOUTS_JSON")"
+  if [[ -n "$o" ]]; then printf '%s' "$o"; else printf '%s' $(( $(phase_cap "$1" timeout_min) * 60 )); fi

+TOOLS="$(jq -r --arg d "$TOOLS_DEFAULT" '.phase_defaults.tools // $d | if type == "array" then join(",") else . end' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
+EFFORT_FLAG="$(jq -r '.effort // .toggles.effort // empty' <<<"$ARM_DEF")"
+case "$EFFORT_FLAG" in ""|low|medium|high|xhigh|max) ;; *) die_usage "arm effort '$EFFORT_FLAG' is not low|medium|high|xhigh|max" ;; esac
+

+  if [[ -n "$REFUSAL" ]]; then echo "pipeline-run.sh: refused: $REFUSAL" >&2; exit 2; fi

+  single="$(jq -r '.context_resets == false' <<<"$SUITE_TOGGLES")"

+  i=0
+  while IFS=$'\t' read -r name label; do
+    i=$((i + 1))
+    sess=new
+    if [[ "$single" == true ]]; then case "$name" in PLAN|IMPLEMENT|FIX) sess=implementer ;; esac; fi
+    cond=""; [[ "$name" == FIX ]] && cond=" when=CHANGES_REQUIRED"
+    printf 'phase %d %s model=%s max_turns=%s timeout_s=%s effort=%s session=%s%s\n' "$i" "$label" \
+      "$(phase_model "$name")" "$(phase_cap "$name" max_turns)" "$(phase_timeout_s "$name")" \
+      "${EFFORT_FLAG:--}" "$sess" "$cond"
+  done < <(jq -r '.[] | [.name, .label] | @tsv' <<<"$plan")
+  exit 0
+fi
+
+# --- run directory --------------------------------------------------------------
+if [[ -e "$RUN_DIR" ]] && [[ -n "$(ls -A "$RUN_DIR" 2>/dev/null)" ]]; then
+  die_usage "run dir exists and is not empty: $RUN_DIR"
+fi
+mkdir -p "$RUN_DIR"
+RUN_DIR="$(cd "$RUN_DIR" && pwd)"
+WS="$RUN_DIR/sandbox" META="$RUN_DIR/meta" SNAPS="$RUN_DIR/snapshots" TRANS="$RUN_DIR/transcripts" EVALD="$RUN_DIR/eval"
+mkdir -p "$WS" "$META" "$SNAPS" "$TRANS" "$EVALD"
+printf '%s\n' "$ARM" > "$META/arm"
+PHASES_FILE="$META/phases.jsonl"; : > "$PHASES_FILE"
+export ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE="$META/arm-evidence.txt"; : > "$ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE"
+MOUNT_LOG="$META/mount.log"; : > "$MOUNT_LOG"
+
+STARTED="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
+STATUS="running" CAP_PHASE="" CAP_TURN="null" REASON="" FINAL_WRITTEN=0
+INTERRUPTED=0 CUR_PID="" CUR_CONTAINER=""

+now_ms() {  # epoch milliseconds; whole seconds × 1000 where date has no %N (BSD date)
+  local t; t="$(date +%s%N)"

+infra() { finish infrastructure_error 2 "$*"; }

+resolve_rel() {  # resolve_rel <relpath> → first existing dir among the candidate roots
+  local rel="$1" c

+    [[ -d "$c" ]] && { (cd "$c" && pwd); return 0; }
+  done
+  return 1
+}
+sgit() {  # git on the sandbox repo, isolated from the operator's git config
+  env -i PATH="$PATH" HOME="$META" GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 LC_ALL=C \
+    git -C "$WS" "$@"

+  lib_call check_fixture_path_rule "$FIXTURE_DIR"

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# =============================================================================
+# pipeline-run.sh — the cycle-130 ablation pipeline executor (SDD §1.4 D-4.1 … D-4.10, §5.6)
+#
+# Runs ONE task under ONE arm: materialises a sandbox repository (the task's
+# fixture tree, or the review-catch PR under pr/, plus the Loa mount from the
+# pinned --source-tree), then drives Loa's phases as separate `claude -p`
+# sessions inside it, records every phase, enforces the per-run cap and writes
+# meta/pipeline.json. One executor serves every task type (D-4.1):
+#   review-catch                      REVIEW → AUDIT
+#   bug-fix | refactor | feature-build PLAN → IMPLEMENT → REVIEW → FIX? → AUDIT → FIX?
+# A FIX runs only when the gate before it wrote a CHANGES_REQUIRED LOA-VERDICT
+# trailer (the last `<!-- LOA-VERDICT {…} -->` line of
+# grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/engineer-feedback.md resp. auditor-sprint-feedback.md);
+# a FIX that does not run is recorded `skipped: true`.
+# Arms edit the phase set (D-4.2): `sprint_plan: false` drops PLAN; `gates: false`
+# ends after IMPLEMENT; `loa_mount: false` runs one BARE session (no mount);
+# `flatline: false` keeps PLAN with the Flatline step off; `context_resets: false`
+# runs PLAN, IMPLEMENT and FIX as ONE implementer session (`--resume <session_id>`
+# from the first session's system/init event) while REVIEW and AUDIT stay separate.
+# The suite's `phase_sets[<review-catch|build>]` and an arm's `phases` override the
+# default phase list; the toggle edits above apply on top.
+#
+# Usage:
+#   pipeline-run.sh --task-yaml F --arm ID --run-dir D --run-id R --trial N \
+#                   --source-tree DIR --suite-file F [--max-run-usd 12] \
+#                   [--executor container|host] [--image IMG] [--claude-bin B] \
+#                   [--docker-bin D] [--phase-models JSON] [--phase-timeouts JSON] [--dry-run]
+#
+# Options:
+#   --task-yaml F       task.yaml (SDD §3.2); its directory holds TASK.md
+#   --arm ID            arm id declared in the suite file (`arms[].id`)
+#   --run-dir D         run directory to create (must not exist or be empty);
+#                       alias --workspace
+#   --run-id R          run id recorded in pipeline.json
+#   --trial N           trial number
+#   --source-tree DIR   the pinned Loa tree the mount is copied from
+#   --suite-file F      evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml (read with yq -o=json)
+#   --max-run-usd USD   per-run cap (default 12; config evals.ablation.run_cap_usd)
+#   --executor MODE     container (default; DEC-0411) or host
+#   --image IMG         container image (default loa-ablation:258)
+#   --claude-bin B      host-mode CLI (default $EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN, else claude)
+#   --docker-bin D      docker CLI (default $EVAL_DOCKER_BIN, else docker)
+#   --phase-models JSON {"PLAN": "<model id>", …} override ($LOA_EVAL_PHASE_MODELS)
+#   --phase-timeouts JSON {"IMPLEMENT": <seconds>, …} override
+#   --dry-run           print the phase plan and exit 0; nothing is created
+#
+# Run directory layout (DEC-0413 — the grader never reads meta/):
+#   sandbox/     the agent's tree (its own .git initialised at `base`)

+#                prompt-<label>.md, arm, arm-evidence.txt, arm-env, refused.json,
+#                home/ (container mode: the per-run HOME; deleted at exit)

+# stream-json --verbose --model <id> --permission-mode bypassPermissions
+# --dangerously-skip-permissions --setting-sources project --tools <list>

+# --- per-run HOME (container mode; DEC-0411 as amended in Sprint 258) -------------------------
+# One writable host directory mounted at /home/evaluser: the CLI's session store lives
+# there for the whole run (A6 --resume continues across phases), and it holds only the
+# codex CLI's own files. ~/.claude/.credentials.json and ~/.claude/settings.json are never
+# copied: the Bedrock route authenticates from AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK in the environment,
+# and --setting-sources project ignores user settings.
+CREDS_HOME="${LOA_EVAL_CREDS_HOME:-$HOME}"
+make_home() {
+  local f
+  mkdir -p "$HOME_DIR/.claude" "$HOME_DIR/.aws" "$HOME_DIR/.codex"
+  # the sandbox project is pre-trusted so the mounted tree's project settings apply without the dialog
+  # (the CLI otherwise ignores permissions.allow and warns; lead, Sprint 258 smoke)
+  printf '{"projects":{"/workspace":{"hasTrustDialogAccepted":true}}}\n' > "$HOME_DIR/.claude.json"
+  for f in auth.json config.toml; do
+    if [[ -f "$CREDS_HOME/.codex/$f" ]]; then cp "$CREDS_HOME/.codex/$f" "$HOME_DIR/.codex/$f"; fi
+  done
+  chmod 0700 "$HOME_DIR" "$HOME_DIR/.claude" "$HOME_DIR/.aws" "$HOME_DIR/.codex"
+}
+[[ "$EXECUTOR" == container ]] && make_home

+# --- pricing (one lookup per model; D-4.10) ---------------------------------------------
+PRICE_CACHE=""
+price_for() {  # price_for <model id> → {"in":…,"out":…,"cr":…,"cc":…} micro-USD per Mtok, or null
+  local m="$1" hit alias j
+  hit="$(printf '%s\n' "$PRICE_CACHE" | awk -F'\t' -v m="$m" '$1 == m {print $2; exit}')"
+  [[ -n "$hit" ]] && { printf '%s' "$hit"; return 0; }
+  if [[ -n "${LOA_EVAL_PRICING_JSON:-}" ]]; then
+    j="$(jq -c --arg m "$m" '.[$m] // null' <<<"$LOA_EVAL_PRICING_JSON" 2>/dev/null || echo null)"
+  else
+    alias="$(printf '%s' "$m" | sed -E 's/^([a-z]+\.)?anthropic\.//; s/-v[0-9]+(:[0-9]+)?$//')"
+    j="$(cd "$REPO_ROOT/.claude/adapters" && python3 -I "$REPO_ROOT/.claude/adapters/loa_cheval/metering/pricing.py" \
+          --alias "$alias" --json 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1p' || true)"
+    [[ -n "$j" ]] || j=null
+  fi
+  j="$(jq -c 'if (type == "object") and (.input_per_mtok != null) and (.output_per_mtok != null)
+              then {in: .input_per_mtok, out: .output_per_mtok,
+                    cr: (.cache_read_per_mtok // (.input_per_mtok * 0.1)),
+                    cc: (.cache_write_per_mtok // .cache_creation_per_mtok // (.input_per_mtok * 1.25))}
+              else null end' <<<"$j" 2>/dev/null || echo null)"
+  PRICE_CACHE="$PRICE_CACHE$m"$'\t'"$j"$'\n'
+  printf '%s' "$j"
+}
+# price_events <events> <prices> <budget_micro> → "<turns> <estimate_micro> <crossing_turn|0>"
+price_events() {
+  jq -R -n -r --argjson p "$2" --argjson budget "$3" '
+    def cost(u): ((u.input_tokens // 0) * $p.in + (u.output_tokens // 0) * $p.out
+                  + (u.cache_read_input_tokens // 0) * $p.cr + (u.cache_creation_input_tokens // 0) * $p.cc) / 1000000;
+    reduce (inputs | fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .type == "assistant"
+                                        and ((.message.usage // null) | type) == "object")) as $e
+      ({order: [], u: {}, n: 0};
+       .n += 1
+       | ($e.message.id // ("event-" + (.n | tostring))) as $id
+       | (if .u[$id] == null then .order += [$id] else . end)
+       | .u[$id] = $e.message.usage)
+    | [.order[] as $id | cost(.u[$id])] as $c
+    | (reduce range(0; $c | length) as $i ({s: 0, x: 0};
+         if .x == 0 then (.s += $c[$i]) | (if .s >= $budget then .x = ($i + 1) else . end) else . end)) as $r
+    | "\($c | length) \(($c | add // 0) | round) \($r.x)"' 2>/dev/null < "$1" || echo "0 0 0"
+}

+# --- phase execution ----------------------------------------------------------------
+IMPL_SESSION="" LAST_VERDICT="none" CUR_LABEL=""
+in_container_path() { local p="$1"; printf '%s' "/workspace${p#"$WS"}"; }
